scale.1: Sparse elementary patterns with ample preparation time.
scale.2: Simple two-hand accompaniment and short predictable patterns.
scale.3: Intermediate independent melody/accompaniment, recurring arpeggios and moderate register changes.
scale.4: Advanced continuous patterns, wide transfers, ornaments or sustained dense texture.
scale.5: The most demanding current arrangements: fast dense passages, difficult coordination and substantial register/chord work.

basis: Editorial review of each exact MIDI edition at 100% source tempo, calibrated to the learner-requested examples. Not an examination grade, a judgement of the composition title, or a note-density formula. Hand statistics describe source layers, not mandatory fingering.
